intro: We are looking for talented and motivated postdoctoral fellows, Ph.D. students, and undergraduate students to join us. Please contact Dr. Mengdi Han by email if you are interested.

roles.label: Postdoctoral Fellow
roles.title: Postdoctoral Fellow
roles.body:
Please contact Dr. Mengdi Han by EMAIL and include your CV and representative publications. We will contact shortlisted candidates to schedule onsite or online interviews. We accept application throughout the year, but please be aware of the deadline of Peking University Boya Postdoctoral Fellowship (https://postdocs.pku.edu.cn/). The application of Boya Postdoctoral Fellowship usually ends in March and October.

Requirements:

  • Younger than 35, received the Ph.D. degree within 3 years
  • Ph.D. degree in electrical engineering, biomedical engineering, materials science and engineering, chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, or other related fields
  • Strong publication record
  • We prefer applicants with the expertise in biosensors, embedded system, machine learning, and finite element analysis

Benefits:

  • Pre-tax yearly income >400,000 RMB for applicants with Boya Postdoctoral Fellowship
  • Registered permanent residence in Beijing
  • Opportunities to apply grants from the National Natural Science Foundation and other funding agencies
  • Opportunities to promote to senior research positions at Peking University
  • Children of postdocs can attend the kindergarten and primary school affiliated to Peking University

Principal Responsibilities:

  • Lead projects related to wearable and/or implantable devices
  • Publish research work in reputable journals
  • Present research work in domestic and international conferences
  • Provide technical support and mentorship to graduate and undergraduate students

roles.label: Ph.D. Student
roles.title: Ph.D. Student
roles.body:
We are looking for Ph.D. students that are self-motivated, assiduous, creative, and collaborative.

Undergraduate students

Please apply the Summer Camp in College of Future Technology at Peking University. Application usually ends in mid-June. Please pay close attention to the news announced in https://admission.pku.edu.cn/. Motivated students from all backgrounds are encouraged to contact Dr. Mengdi Han by EMAIL with your CV and transcripts.

Master students

Please apply the Ph.D. Program in College of Future Technology at Peking University. Application usually ends in early-December. Please pay close attention to the news announced in https://admission.pku.edu.cn/. Motivated students from all backgrounds are encouraged to contact Dr. Mengdi Han by EMAIL with your CV, transcripts, and representative publications.

roles.label: Undergraduate Student
roles.title: Undergraduate Student
roles.body:
We welcome undergrads from all backgrounds at Peking University to participate in our latest multidisciplinary research projects. Please contact Dr. Mengdi Han by EMAIL if you are interested. Project areas include but not limited to:

  • wearable and implantable devices
  • micro and nano fabrication
  • data analytics and machine learning

roles.label: Research Assistant
roles.title: Research Assistant
roles.body: We do NOT have positions for research assistants.
